description: Show when a job's artifacts will be deleted: each file with its creation time and the date its retention window ends. Use when the user asks how long results are kept, and unprompted after a job finishes — the clock is otherwise invisible, which is how finished work quietly disappears. Read-only and free. Artifacts expire; a volume does not, so copy anything that matters onto one before the window closes.
name: get_artifact_expiry
